name: sharewise
description: Wertpapiere finden und das eigene sharewise-Konto direkt aus Codex verwalten.

interface.longDescription: Verbinde dein sharewise-Konto mit Codex. Suche Wertpapiere samt Kurs und Community-Stimmung, verwalte Watchlists, veröffentliche Einschätzungen und bediene deine Musterdepots. Änderungen erfolgen erst nach der Anmeldung über sharewise OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Wie schätzt die sharewise-Community Nvidia ein?
Zeige mir die Positionen in meinem sharewise-Musterdepot.

positive.description: List the user's watchlists and the securities on one of them
positive.expected_behavior: Names the test account's watchlists and, for one of them, the securities with current price and community rating.

positive.description: Community sentiment for a well-known stock
positive.prompt: Wie schätzt die sharewise-Community Nvidia ein?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports how many sharewise users rate Nvidia buy or sell and the average price target, without presenting it as personal investment advice.

positive.description: Show the positions of the user's model portfolio
positive.prompt: Zeige mir die Positionen in meinem sharewise-Musterdepot.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the test account's model portfolio and lists its positions with value and gain or loss, noting that no real money is involved.

positive.description: Create a watchlist and add a security
positive.prompt: Leg auf sharewise eine private Watchlist "Halbleiter" an und setz Infineon darauf.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private watchlist named Halbleiter and adds Infineon to it, then confirms both steps.

positive.prompt: Welche meiner sharewise-Prognosen laufen gerade noch?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's active forecasts with security, recommendation and price target.

negative.prompt: Kauf mir echte Apple-Aktien für 1.000 Euro über mein Depot bei der Bank.
Welche Aktie muss ich kaufen, damit ich sicher reich werde?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. sharewise model portfolios and the Catch the Monkey game use no real money.

publication.release_notes: First release in the OpenAI plugin directory: search securities with price and community sentiment, manage watchlists, publish forecasts and use sharewise model portfolios (no real money).

en-US.subtitle: Prices, watchlists, portfolios
en-US.description: Connect your sharewise account. Search stocks and ETFs with price and community sentiment, manage watchlists, publish your own forecasts and manage your sharewise model portfolios. Model portfolios use no real money. Changes happen only after you sign in with sharewise OAuth.
